tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, body text, figures, ids and the default icon colour. Text on base, raised, hover and selected in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Section labels, spec-sheet keys, notes, empty-state sentences, axis text, blockquotes. Text on base, raised, hover and selected; never for a value the reader must act on.

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: Page ground, the top bar and the table body. Every text token is checked on it.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The selected hypothesis row, the spec card and chart-less panels that need lifting one step. Never a fill for a whole region: structure is drawn with rules.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of table rows, tree nodes and menu items.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Ground of the active tree node, tag chips, the selected time region and info notifications. One step above hover.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between rows, around the spec card and under the top bar, chart gridlines. A decorative line, never text and never the only sign of a state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Table header underline, blockquote rule, the selected hypothesis series in the chart, the confidential mark. A mark colour: 3:1 on every ground it sits on.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Orange for limits and signals only: the index stripes under the top bar, the selected-row mark, the noise bar, the sealed-lockbox icon, action borders, focus rings. Never a text colour (use accent-text) and never decoration.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of links and action fills; link text on hover on base, raised and hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange set as text: links, tertiary action labels, the "view evolution tree" link. Text on base, raised, hover and selected.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text or glyph set on an accent fill, for example the unclassified marking and Astro inverse text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Passing, supported, confirmed: the rux-status symbol and check-ledger pass mark. A mark: pair it with a word or shape, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Pending, inconclusive, unresolved material: rux-status caution and the warning notification edge. A mark colour.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Refuted, failed or exhausted: rux-status critical, failed checks, error notification. A mark colour.

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: The research direction as the page title. One per page; 22px below 900px.
styles.sample: 时间序列动量在交易成本之后还有效吗？

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Hypothesis title at the top of the spec card.

styles.name: heading-reading
styles.usage: Headings inside rendered library pages and hypothesis notes (20px for h1, 16px h2, 14px h3 and h4; 13px inside the spec card).

styles.name: text-reading
styles.usage: Library pages, hypothesis notes and the page lede (the page lede and reason sentences at 1.7).
styles.sample: 一个资产自己过去的收益，对它下一段收益有预测力。

styles.name: text-field
styles.usage: Spec-sheet values, check-ledger rows, tree rows.

styles.name: text-note
styles.usage: Chart caption under a section label.
styles.sample: 150 次试验，其中 13 次程序失败（未画出）。

styles.name: label-section
styles.usage: Section labels above the table, chart, timeline, events and inside the spec card. Muted, never a heading level.

styles.name: label-spec
styles.usage: Spec-sheet keys and Markdown table headers. Muted.

styles.name: data-cell
styles.usage: Numbers and ids in table cells. Tabular numerals, left-aligned under their header.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Check-ledger values, inline code, code blocks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: tag padding, icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding in ledgers and trees, gap between a mark and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between spec-sheet key and value, padding in code blocks, gap before section labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap under a section label, page gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside the spec card, gap above a notification.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page head and tabs, between grid columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding, gap between page sections, library column gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page.

tokens.name: side-width
tokens.usage: Width of the spec-card column beside the table.

tokens.name: spec-key-width
tokens.usage: Width of the key column in a spec sheet.

tokens.name: library-nav-width
tokens.usage: Width of the library tree beside the reader.

tokens.name: stripe-height
tokens.usage: Height of the index stripes under the top bar.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner is square, in every component. Astro and Carbon radii are mapped to it.
